name: Dagger: Yuushiki no Ikusabito
source:
Several days after the events of Frontlines of the War... 

Tisto and Aisis visit the spiritlands to repay their spared lives. 

Waiting for them is a room and a culture unlike any ever seen before, 
and the bewildered duo are given a rough welcome and a request: 

"Our world thrives on help from the humans. 
For that reason, as necessary, we must submit to them." 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095507.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
战争前线事件发生几天后…… 

蒂斯托和艾西斯前往灵境报答他们的幸免。

等待他们的是一个前所未有的房间和文化，
困惑的两人受到了粗暴的欢迎，并提出了一个要求：

“我们的世界依靠人类的帮助而繁荣发展。
因此，必要时我们必须服从他们。” 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095507.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
